title: Is CompTIA Security+ Worth It in 2026? (Honest Verdict)
dek: Yes, for most people breaking into cybersecurity: Security+ is affordable, has no experience requirement, and is requested by name in entry-level and government-adjacent job postings. It is not worth it if you are already experienced.

seo.metaTitle: Is CompTIA Security+ Worth It in 2026?
seo.metaDescription: An honest verdict on CompTIA Security+ — real exam cost, what it gets you, who it's for, and who should skip it and spend the money elsewhere.

sources.label: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Information Security Analysts, Occupational Outlook Handbook

body.richText: CompTIA Security+ is the most common entry-level cybersecurity certification, which means it is also the most over-hyped and the most unfairly dismissed, depending on who you ask. Here is the honest verdict — including the real cost and who should not bother.

The verdict: worth it for career entrants and career-changers who need a recognized credential to get past recruiter screens. Not worth it if you already work in security or already hold a higher certification.

The Security+ (SY0-701) exam voucher runs roughly $400 to $440 from CompTIA — the company raised prices across its lineup in 2026, so confirm the current figure before buying. Add study materials and a possible retake, and a realistic all-in budget is a few hundred dollars more. Always check CompTIA's official page for the live price.

items: No experience prerequisite — genuinely accessible to beginners
Requested by name in a large share of entry-level security postings
Vendor-neutral, so the knowledge transfers across employers and tools
Meets baseline requirements for many U.S. government and contractor roles
Relatively affordable compared with advanced certifications
It is a knowledge exam — passing it does not prove hands-on ability
It will not, by itself, get you hired without fundamentals and some hands-on practice
If you already have security experience or a higher cert, it adds little
The credential expires and requires renewal, an ongoing cost

body.richText: Who it is not for: experienced practitioners, and anyone hoping a single exam replaces IT fundamentals and lab work. Security+ is a door-opener, not a finish line.

items.answerRichText: The exam voucher is roughly $400 to $440 as of 2026, after CompTIA raised prices. Study materials and a possible retake add to that. Check CompTIA's official page for the current price before you buy.

items.question: Is Security+ worth it if I already work in IT?
items.answerRichText: Often yes, if you are pivoting from general IT into security — it formalizes security fundamentals and satisfies employer or contract requirements. If you already work in security, its value drops sharply.
